description.value: Swad Indian Kitchen is a family-owned North Indian restaurant on Marine Drive in West Vancouver, founded by Kamal Mroke who arrived from Punjab in the early 1980s and worked his way from dishwasher to restaurateur over 35 years. The menu spans aromatic curries, tandoori dishes, and street food classics, with strong vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free coverage. A private dining room with ocean views is available for groups, and free parking is provided at the rear of the building.
